# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(scales)
here::i_am("reports/GA4/04_ga4_content_engagement.qmd")
read_clean <- function(x) read_csv(here("data", "clean", "GA4", x), show_col_types = FALSE)
pages <- read_clean("ga4_pages_and_screens_clean.csv")
landing <- read_clean("ga4_landing_pages_clean.csv")
traffic <- read_clean("ga4_traffic_acquisition_clean.csv")
events <- read_clean("ga4_events_clean.csv")
```

# Page views

```{r}
top_pages <- pages |>
  filter(page_path_standardised != "(not set)") |>
  arrange(desc(views)) |>
  transmute(page = page_path_standardised, views, active_users,
    views_per_active_user = round(views_per_active_user, 2),
    average_engagement_seconds = round(average_engagement_time_per_active_user, 1)) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
knitr::kable(top_pages)
```

# Landing pages

```{r}
top_landing_pages <- landing |>
  arrange(desc(sessions)) |>
  transmute(landing_page = landing_page_standardised, sessions, active_users,
    new_users, average_engagement_seconds = round(average_engagement_time_per_session, 1),
    key_events) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
knitr::kable(top_landing_pages)

landing_quality <- landing |>
  summarise(
    total_sessions = sum(sessions),
    not_set_sessions = sum(sessions[landing_page_original == "(not set)"], na.rm = TRUE),
    not_set_share = not_set_sessions / total_sessions
  )
knitr::kable(mutate(landing_quality, not_set_share = percent(not_set_share, 0.1)))
```

# Engagement rate and average engagement time

Engagement rate and average engagement time per session are available by
channel, while average engagement time per active user is available by page.
They have different denominators and are shown separately.

```{r}
engagement_by_channel <- traffic |>
  arrange(desc(sessions)) |>
  transmute(channel, sessions,
    engagement_rate = percent(engagement_rate, 0.1),
    average_engagement_seconds_per_session = round(average_engagement_time_per_session, 1))
knitr::kable(engagement_by_channel)

review_pages <- pages |>
  filter(views >= 100, average_engagement_time_per_active_user < 10,
    page_path_standardised != "(not set)") |>
  arrange(average_engagement_time_per_active_user, desc(views)) |>
  select(page_path_standardised, views, active_users,
    average_engagement_time_per_active_user)
knitr::kable(slice_head(review_pages, n = 30))
```

# Events and conversions

```{r}
event_table <- events |>
  arrange(desc(event_count)) |>
  transmute(event_name, event_category, event_count, total_users,
    event_count_per_active_user = round(event_count_per_active_user, 2))
knitr::kable(event_table)

conversion_audit <- tibble(
  potential_conversion_event_types = sum(events$event_category == "Potential business conversion"),
  reported_key_events_all_exports = sum(traffic$key_events) + sum(landing$key_events) + sum(pages$key_events),
  interpretation = "Event activity exists, but conversions cannot be reported because supplied Key Event totals are zero"
)
knitr::kable(conversion_audit)
```
